curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a father keep his sons safe as an unhuman threat sends their journey into greater danger?
curatedMovie.description: A decorated Marine embarks on a high-stakes rescue mission to protect his two young sons from an unhuman threat, setting off on a journey where escalating danger forces the boys to leave their childhoods behind.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful drama driven by protective dread, medium pacing, and engaged solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Michael Pearce blends a grounded dramatic mystery with escalating thriller suspense, anchoring an unhuman menace in the raw, protective bond between a father and his sons.
